I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the consistently excellent service provided by Manor Road Surgery in Beckenham. The surgery consistently manages a high patient volume with remarkable efficiency. This is due in no small part to the exceptional dedication of the staff. I would particularly like to commend Debbie and the entire team for their unfailing helpfulness and unwavering support. Furthermore, the reception staff consistently demonstrate a proactive approach in accommodating patients' needs for appointments with the highly professional doctors. Their efforts to ensure patients receive timely and appropriate care are truly commendable. I am immensely grateful for their dedicated service, which exemplifies how the National Health Service should operate.

Please continue to do an excellent
